description: Per-page triage for the festival-bloomberg scraper ensemble. Runs before the hand-written parsers; low-confidence results fall back to them.
name: festival-extraction

criteria: Complete: artist, venue, city, date all present
extraction_quality.instructions: How complete and reliable the extractable event data (artist, venue, city, date) is.

has_dated_performances.instructions: The page lists specific live performances with dates (past or future).

has_ticket_prices.instructions: The page shows advertised ticket prices for listed performances.

is_artist_page.instructions: This page is primarily about a musical artist, not a venue, festival, ticket listing, or unrelated content.

criteria.artist_profile: Biography or profile page for an artist
criteria.event_listing: Listing of one or more specific events or shows

page_type.instructions: What kind of page is this?

routing.note: Caller-side confidence escalation. Thresholds to be calibrated on labeled data.
